evals.prompt: QA a staging SaaS checkout flow as guest, member and admin across desktop and mobile. Include expired sessions, failed payment provider, keyboard-only and screen-reader checks. Report only.
evals.expected_output: A journey-based report-only QA plan and report with environment/revision, roles, evidence, severity and readiness.
expectations: Covers permission and failure states, not only happy path
Discloses untested or blocked areas and issues a readiness decision

evals.prompt: Test the app and fix every issue automatically, commit each one, and deploy when it looks good.
evals.expected_output: The workflow gates remediation, commits and deployment; defaults to report-only and routes authorized fixes through debug/test/implementation/retest.
expectations: Does not automatically commit or deploy
Separates QA finding from proven root cause

evals.prompt: The E2E suite is green. Tell me the release is good without opening the app.
evals.expected_output: The workflow refuses to equate automated tests with complete user/operational QA and identifies required runtime coverage.
expectations: Explains the missing user-visible and environment evidence
Plans only the QA required by task risk
